summary.title: About Me
summary.p1: I'm an AI Engineer based in Cairo, specializing in computer vision, backend systems, and applied generative AI. I help teams turn ambitious ideas — satellite monitoring, biometric attendance, AI-powered CRMs — into fast, reliable products, from the first data pipeline to a live deployment.
summary.p2: Recent work includes a bilingual AI sales assistant built into a CRM, a satellite-based water-monitoring system for agriculture, and a real-time facial recognition attendance platform — each shipped end-to-end with FastAPI, Docker, and cloud-ready ML pipelines. If you need a computer vision model in production, an LLM-powered workflow, or a dedicated AI engineer for your team, I can help you get there.
